text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Navy lace-edge fitted camisole and matching tiered ruffle mini skirt, brown peep-toe platform high heels.. Add ONLY these accessories: brown leather belt with ornate large bronze conchos and long hanging tail; small structured brown leather top-handle bag; brown softly cat-eye sunglasses; pair of thin large metallic hoop earrings; delicate fine gold pendant necklace. Closed inventory: use each listed item exactly once and add no other objects.
original_prompt: Create one photorealistic COMPLETE hollow wardrobe outfit on pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, entire ensemble and accessories fully inside margins. Image 1 is the exact empty clothing ensemble; preserve its garments, shoes, materials and proportions. Image 2 is the original styling reference; use ONLY the outfit at 下排中. Add ONLY the following closed accessory inventory, each once: brown leather belt with ornate large bronze conchos and long hanging tail; small structured brown leather top-handle bag; brown softly cat-eye sunglasses; pair of thin large metallic hoop earrings; delicate fine gold pendant necklace. Place these actual accessories as styled in the reference using invisible supports; bags may sit beside the ensemble. NO person, hair, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stands. Preserve empty negative space where body would be. Do not invent ANY additional belts, scarves, ties, bags, jewelry, props or garment layers. No text, watermark, border, collage or duplicate accessories.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
